messages:
Ria: quick heads-up — I'm updating the troubleshooting reference to add a short runtime failover cheatsheet. Need two SDK snippets (JS + Python) showing exponential backoff + fallback to a lighter model when we hit 429s/timeouts. Anyone free to review the PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432

Sam: I can review. Should we also include a recommended retry cap (max 3) and jitter? We should match SDK defaults so users don't get surprised.

Jules: yes, and add a short note about context trimming before retrying (drop nonessential history). Maybe show a tiny helper for prompt truncation.

Ria: added draft snippets in the branch and pushed. Pinging DocsBot to open the PR and attach the snippets checklist. :wave:

DocsBot: PR opened by Ria — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — reviewers: Sam, Jules. CI: docs-lint, snippets-check queued. :robot_face:

Sam: quick feedback on the JS snippet — it's using setTimeout raw. Prefer using the SDK retry helper so default instrumentation + metrics are consistent. Suggest replacing with:
```js
// recommended usage (pseudo)
await client.generate(
  { model: 'redwood-large', input: prompt },
  { retries: 3, backoff: 'exponential', jitter: true }
);
```
Also add a short line: on persistent 429s, fallback to a cheaper variant ('redwood-small') and log the decision.

Ria: good point. I'll swap to the SDK helper. Also adding a curl example for operators showing headers to inspect for rate-limit info:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
That helps when debugging 429 vs network timeouts.

Leo: small nit — the draft links to the context-limits page are broken. Should be /docs/limits/context (not /docs/context-limits). I'll open a tiny link-fix PR unless someone beats me to it.

Jules: LGTM after Sam's change + Leo's link fix. One suggestion: add a one-line example for trimming with token-count check, e.g. drop older turns until tokens < max_context.

Ria: perfect. I'll push the edits tonight and add an explicit release-note blurb under Troubleshooting -> graceful degradation & fallbacks. @Sam @Jules @Leo please approve once CI is green. :memo:

Sam: will review first thing tomorrow morning :eyes:
